## Email Attachment Saver to Google Drive

Automatically saves email attachments to organized Drive folders.

**Flow:**
1. Gmail trigger on emails with attachments
2. Code node prepares attachments with date-based folder path
3. Upload each attachment to Google Drive
4. Index file metadata in Google Sheets
5. Reply confirmation to sender

**Setup:**
- Connect Gmail OAuth2 credentials
- Connect Google Drive credentials
- Connect Google Sheets credentials
- Set target Drive folder and Sheets spreadsheet
